units.source_text: 日高时分，京中常陆守夫人派来迎接的人到了。

en.t: Around late morning, the people sent from the capital by the wife of the Governor of Hitachi to escort her arrived.

units.source_text: 有车二辆，骑马的七八人，照例是赳赳武夫。

en.t: There were two carriages and seven or eight men on horseback, all fierce-looking warriors as usual.

units.source_text: 此外尚有随从的男子多人，

en.t: Besides them, there were many male attendants as well,

units.source_text: 都是粗蠢之辈，操着东国方言纷纷地进来了。

en.t: all crude and dull fellows, who came crowding in while speaking in eastern-country dialect.

units.source_text: 众侍女讨厌他们，叫他们躲进那边的屋子里去。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting disliked them and told them to withdraw into the rooms over there.

units.source_text: 如果骗他们说薰大将在此，

en.t: If I lie to them and say that Captain Kaoru is here,

units.source_text: 则如此高贵的人物在不在京中，外人自然知道，

en.t: outsiders would naturally know whether such a noble person was in the capital or not,
so there is no way to deceive them."
So, without consulting the other ladies-in-waiting,

units.source_text: 独自写一封信给常陆守夫人，

en.t: she wrote a letter on her own to the wife of the Governor of Hitachi,

units.source_text: 信中言道：“小姐昨夜月信忽至，

en.t: saying in the letter, "Last night our young lady's monthly period suddenly began,

units.source_text: 今日不便进香，实甚遗憾。

en.t: so today it is not suitable for her to go and offer incense, which is truly regrettable.

units.source_text: 加之昨日夜梦不祥，今日必须斋戒。

en.t: Moreover, last night's dream was inauspicious, so today she must observe ritual abstinence.

units.source_text: 出行之日适逢禁忌，真乃不巧之至。

en.t: For the day of departure to fall exactly on a day of taboo is the height of bad timing.
I fear that some spirit may be deliberately obstructing us."

units.source_text: 她把此信交付来人，请他们吃过酒饭，回返京都。

en.t: She handed this letter to the messengers, served them wine and food, and sent them back to Kyoto.

units.source_text: 她又叫人去告诉老尼姑弁君：“今天禁忌，小姐不赴石山进香了。”

en.t: She also sent someone to tell the old nun Ben no Kimi, "Today is a day of taboo, so the young lady will not go to Ishiyama to offer incense."
